source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared notification test head registers MockOSIntegration for the osintegration service on every platform and restores registration at cleanup. Its DND getter returns a static test Boolean. testNoSoundOnBiffWithDND sets that value true, injects new mail with sounds enabled, and uses the one-second no-sound helper before resetting it. This checks the manager sound gate with a mock; it does not exercise Windows WNF, Linux GSettings or macOS schedule detection. The current task comment still says Windows although the test is no longer Windows-only. No test was run here.
title: The notification DND browser test substitutes the native service on every platform
